release_notes: Large batch of admin fixes and redesigns. Terminal: fixed 'cannot set terminal process group' by launching bash via `script -qefc` for a real controlling tty + job control. Routes: Application now also loads routes/admin.php, fixing /admin/domains (was redirecting to Dashboard) plus radio settings, streams, radio_dashboard and AutoSSL-run (22 routes total). LiveChat: /admin/livechat/export now returns a CSV download instead of 404. WebsiteBuilder: /sites fixed (was 500 - unqualified PDO::FETCH in namespaced controller). AutoDJ: added /admin/autodj page with Start All / Stop All / Restart All controls (verified restart-all works). PHP Manager: now lists all 12 installed PHP versions (5.6-8.5) with a version selector and per-version extension install (apt php{X.Y}-{ext}). Email: rewired to the real mail system (PostfixAdmin SQLite /var/vmail/postfixadmin.db with {BLF-CRYPT} bcrypt); accounts now read from the live mailbox store; added per-account Change Password that updates Dovecot auth. Support KB: added enable/disable toggle for a public /kb page plus a billing-dashboard card showing KB status. MySQL: removed redundant Database Access card. FTP: added Connect via FTP card (File Explorer / FTPS / FileZilla). IP: added IP Pool card showing who is assigned to each IP. Radio Downloads: added Planet Hosts Studio node download (installer hosted). DNS: redesigned with zone cards and BIND9 status. Apache: removed Server Information card. SnappyMail: rebranded to 'Planet Hosts Mail'.
